lines: The game's console. Type a command and Enter; help lists the game's own.
The game's commands (a name alone shows its value, a name and a value sets it):
rd.GameConsole = 1    The game's own console, opened with the console key (`): 1 on, 0 off.
rd.HeroMenu = 0    1: a dungeon level with heroes and a MenuLevel, played without ?Hero=, opens its menu first.
rd.WildRunSpeed = 10    Her running speed in the wilderness (outside the towns' walls), for testing: 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30 or 40 (another number takes the nearest).
help, clear    this list; empty the console
The engine's console variables are read and set the same way (t.MaxFPS 60).
